items.label: Installatie & Init
items.content:
# Installatie & Init

**Include:**
```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/HyperRushNet/hrn-ai/client/1.0.3.min.js"></script>
```

**Init client:**
```javascript
const client = new AIClient({
  apiKey: 'YOUR_API_KEY',
  model: 'flux',
  stream: true,
  isImage: false,
  seed: 12345,
  chatId: 'chat1',
  timeout: 60000,
  retry: true,
  retryAttempts: 2,
  retryDelay: 1000
});
```

# Cleanup
- Auto cleanup: chatId verwijderd na generate of streaming.

  height: 1024,
  seed: 12345,
